label: Hit spark
notes: Everyday contact spark. Place at the strike point: cross flare, then sparks and hot chips along the blow.

label: Blunt hit
notes: Soft or heavy thud. Warm blob, inked wedges, and a dust puff for fists, clubs, and body checks.

label: Critical hit
notes: Hard starburst for a clean or heavy connect. Ring breaks, sparks streak, shards drop.

label: Hit flash
notes: Defender damage flash. White frame, red flush, blink, and comic hit lines on the body that was struck.

label: Impact frame
notes: Full-frame anime speed lines on a beat. Screen-sized and short: white burst, invert, then the lines pull out.

label: Parry
notes: Clash or block. Blade edges flash in an X, a four-point star rings, gold sparks rain.

label: Ground slam
notes: After a body hits the street. Floor flash, cracks, two shockwaves, dust column, rocks settle.

label: Heavy landing
notes: Landing dust under the feet. Floor dents and cracks; two dust rings roll out with the landing body.

label: Uppercut
notes: Rising chin strike. Crescent climbs past the face and a comic star bursts at the top.

label: Cartoon POW
notes: Readable comic hit. Jagged burst, POW lettering, and action lines on the beat.

label: Dirt explosion
notes: Street grit. Buried flash, dirt clods, a brown dust plume, and a crater left behind.

label: Smoke bomb
notes: Smoke cover after a break or vanish. Canister drops, pops, and the cloud thins to wisps.
